title: Organic chemistry II
purpose: Use NMR spectroscopy, conjugation and aromaticity, electrophilic aromatic substitution, the chemistry of aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids and their derivatives, enolates and amines, and the organic chemistry of biomolecules and drugs.

blocks.deliverable: Solve a structure from a supplied proton NMR spectrum.
Predict directing effects in substituted benzenes.
Rank acyl derivatives by reactivity and explain ester hydrolysis.
Week 7 midterm; explain the aldol reaction and amine basicity.
Draw glucose in open-chain and ring forms.
Explain how a drug's functional groups affect its absorption.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Drug-molecule analysis: for aspirin, acetaminophen and ibuprofen, identify functional groups and stereocenters, explain acidity, and propose likely metabolic reactions.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
